courses.h2: With us, there's a place for everyone.
courses.lede: We teach English to learners of all ages, from six upwards.

items.title: Primary
items.desc: We guide young learners from the very beginning, introducing reading and writing gradually and helping them to see English as a genuinely useful tool.

items.title: Teenagers
items.desc: Grammar, vocabulary and Use of English, worked on systematically to drive progress in all four skills: reading, writing, listening and speaking.

items.title: Adults
items.desc: The same structured method, adapted to an adult's pace and needs: solid foundations in grammar and vocabulary, and constant encouragement to overcome any fear of speaking English.

items.title: Cambridge English exams
items.desc:
A Cambridge English Preparation Centre since 2005.

Every student is placed in a group according to their overall level on the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR).

Those who wish to can certify their level of English, with full preparation using authentic exam materials.

We prepare candidates for the Young Learners exams (Pre A1 Starters, A1 Movers and A2 Flyers), A2 Key, B1 Preliminary, B2 First and C1 Advanced.

items.title: Summer courses
items.desc: Intensive preparation courses for official exams. Refresher courses to keep your level up. Conversation classes. Tailor-made private lessons.

exams.lede: Our students don't just study English – they certify it. We prepare each level in full and enter candidates for the official examinations as a Cambridge English Preparation Centre.

rungs.name: Key (KET)
rungs.desc: The first official certificate, confirming a solid command of everyday written and spoken English.

rungs.name: Preliminary (PET)
rungs.desc: Independent user level. Asked for by many secondary schools and, increasingly, by universities.

rungs.name: First (FCE)
rungs.desc: The most widely requested certificate in Spain, and a common requirement for university degrees and for many job vacancies.

rungs.name: Advanced (CAE)
rungs.desc: Proficient user level. Opens doors to master's degrees, universities abroad and jobs overseas.

exams.yleNote: The Young Learners exams, designed to help children build the same foundations from the age of seven, without pressure.

method.altAparador: A pupil with her hands painted red and blue in the school's window
method.h2:
A method tried
and tested for
over twenty years.
method.lede: We follow a structured progression – the same sequence Cambridge follows in its teaching materials. Nothing is skipped and nothing is improvised.

pillars.title: All five areas in every unit
pillars.text: Reading, writing, listening, speaking and Use of English. Grammar and vocabulary are taught properly, never left to chance.

pillars.title: You move up when you're ready
pillars.text: Nobody moves up simply because the course has finished. Students progress once all five areas are secure – and it is the teacher who decides, with the evidence in front of them.

pillars.title: Teachers who stay
pillars.text: Qualified, experienced and here year after year. Your child won't have a different teacher every term.

insta.lede: News, announcements and moments we'd like to share.

contact.h2:
Come along for a free
trial class.
contact.lede: Bring your child, or come yourself: one class, with no commitment and no pressure, so that you can see how we work before making up your mind.
